subject: Re: LedgePoint security evidence mapping & next steps
messages:
From: Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@ledgepoint.com>

Cc: security@ledgepoint.com
Date: 2026-08-30T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: LedgePoint — follow up + artifact ask

Michael,

Thanks again for the call earlier — helpful overview. I wanted to summarize LedgePoint's immediate asks so our security team can triage internally:

- SOC 2 Type II report or SOC 2 summary and recent control evidence (last 12 months)
- Audit log retention details (what logs, retention windows, how access is restricted)
- Data retention / deletion policy (DPA inclusion points)
- Pen test summary + scope and remediation timeline for any open findings

High-level pain: we must demonstrate to internal risk and legal that third‑party access to customer data is narrow, auditable, and that retention windows match our regulatory needs (7 years for transaction logs).

Can you share a mapping table of each artifact above -> Redwood doc (or a stub) and an estimated delivery timeline? Also please flag anything that typically requires an NDA or formal artifact exchange.

Appreciate it — copying our security alias for visibility.

—Daniel
Daniel Brooks
Head of Risk & Compliance
LedgePoint Financial
[d: +1 415 555 0198]

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T15:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LedgePoint — follow up + artifact ask

Daniel — thanks for the clear list. Per our call, below is a proposed mapping and delivery plan. I copied Karthik (sales) to align contract/DPA touchpoints and Marissa from security to own artifact collection.

Artifact mapping (what we'll provide) and ETA:
- SOC 2: high-level SOC 2 Type II summary + control evidence index (Attachment: SOC2_summary_v2.pdf) — ETA: 3 business days
- Audit logs: extraction spec + retention matrix (which logs, retention windows, export formats, who has access) — ETA: 5 business days
- Retention policy: excerpt + recommended retention settings for transactional logs (Attachment: retention_policy_excerpt.txt) — ETA: 2 business days
- Pen test: executive summary + scope file (Attachment: pen_test_scope.xlsx) and remediation status — ETA: 7 business days for redlines/details

Notes / items that may need an NDA or secure exchange:
- Full SOC 2 report and some control artifacts (raw logs, redacted config screenshots) we typically exchange under an NDA or via a secure share (S3 link with short-lived creds).
- Pen test full report is sensitive and generally shared with a formal request and acceptance of handling terms.

Immediate asks from Redwood to you:
1) Confirm whether a short NDA is acceptable for full artifacts or if your procurement/legal already has a template we should use.
2) Any specific log export format (SIEM type) you prefer — e.g., syslog/CEF/JSON?
3) Preferred contact for DPA negotiation (legal or procurement)? Karthik can coordinate pricing/contract items once the security bar is cleared.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll send the SOC2_summary_v2.pdf and retention excerpt now (attached).
- Marissa will follow up with a checklist for additional evidence and a secure transfer method.
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up with your security lead next week to walk artifacts and answer technical questions.

If that sounds good, I’ll schedule the call.

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwoodinference.com | (650) 555-0123

Michael — thanks, that timeline helps. A few quick clarifications from our security team (copied):

- Retention windows: we specifically need transaction-level audit logs retained for 7 years and immutable backups for 3 years. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports write-once access controls or an append-only mechanism for audit logs?
- Pen test: we will need a one-page summary for leadership plus the full report for our ops team under NDA.
- DPA: procurement prefers to start from our template; I’ll attach it in a separate email if that’s ok.

Forwarding (from our security lead) for context:

Great — appreciate the specifics. Quick confirms and actions:

- Audit export fields: we can include all requested fields (timestamp UTC, user_id, operation, resource_id, source_ip, retention_policy_tag, TTL_expiry). We also log KMS key identifiers and rotation events; Marissa will add the exact KMS log sample in the artifact package.
- Retention: we support configurable retention per log type. For immutable backups, we use write-once buckets with object lock + legal hold for agreed retention windows; we’ll document the process and proof-of-config in the package.
- Pen test: will prepare one-page leadership summary and arrange secure delivery of the full report under NDA.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Michael: share SOC2_summary_v2.pdf and retention excerpt (done).
- Marissa: compile audit export spec, KMS log sample, and pen test exec summary — ETA 5 business days.
- Karthik: review procurement/DPA path and confirm whether to accept LedgePoint template or propose Redwood redlines — ETA 2 business days to respond.
